text: I have heard from residents on Delaware Avenue, between Shanly Street and Hallam Street, who shared that there is a lack of available on-street parking for permit holders. Through conversations with residents, there are clear inconsistencies in the permit parking regulations between this block and the section south of Shanly Street, resulting in unintended parking pressures for local residents. While permit parking on Delaware Avenue south of Shanly Street is in effect overnight until 10:00 a.m., the shorter and standard permit parking period on the block north of Shanly Street creates an opportunity for drivers to leave their vehicles to avoid the longer parking restriction. As a result, residents on this block have experienced reduced access to on-street permit parking near their homes, which makes it more difficult to find available spaces.
